name: spec-only-merge-defect-recorded
body:
A spec-only project merge leaves main's db.lbug free of the merged authored nodes/edges while graph.jsonl carries them. rust.apg.splice.apply.apply (src/splice/apply.rs:141) matches only Language/Module/Struct/Function/File and falls through `_ => {}` (line 228); rust.apg.splice.publish.publish (src/splice/publish.rs:53) writes graph.jsonl from the full assembled graph via rust.apg.load.export.write_graph_jsonl while swapping in the seeded+spliced db.lbug; rust.apg.scan.cmd_scan (src/scan.rs:181) fast-paths on rust.apg.git.state.is_fresh, which reads graph.jsonl line 1 (rust.apg.git.state.recorded_scan), a line rust.apg.git.commit.reanchor_scan_meta rewrites while leaving the DB Scan row untouched.

The requirement tree sits under requirements.requirement.spec-only-merge-leaves-main-db-stale, the domain group is domain.group.splice-equivalence, and the eligibility-guard spine carries the remediation. The remediation is stated as the invariant (a splice equals a full rebuild for authored/transient tables too) plus a refusal-and-full-load eligibility guard, leaving the implementation open.
